typography.installation: Ensure fonts are imported via Google Fonts in index.css

rules: Use #2563EB strategically for active states and primary CTAs.
Never use pure black or pure white for text; use slated neutral tints.

layouts.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900

rules: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers.
Ensure cards have solid backgrounds so content inside is always readable.

charts.usage: Use Recharts for Area, Bar, and Pie charts. Ensure tooltips have solid backgrounds matching the surface color with borders.

table.header: text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 dark:text-slate-400 border-b
table.row: border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors

badges.base: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border
badges.success: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20

rules: No transition: all. Use specific properties.

accessibility.aria_labels: Ensure all icon-only buttons have aria-labels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

media.rules: Use these images for dummy data representing users.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium React (Vite) + Tailwind CSS dashboard.
Do NOT center the main app container. Dashboards must take full viewport width and use a sidebar layout.
Implement a dark/light mode toggle in the Settings or Topbar.

Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layouts and basic interactive components if Shadcn UI is not pre-installed or complex. If you generate your own components, ensure they match the 'surfaces_and_cards' specifications exactly.
Ensure the sidebar navigation clearly indicates the active state with the primary color (#2563EB or slate-100 depending on mode).
Use Recharts for the Analytics/Performance charts. Make them responsive.
Make sure all files are valid .jsx / .js. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx) as instructed.
Generate dummy JSON data for students matching the 'Batch' values: Super 30, Super 11, Last 15 Days, Last 40 Days, and 'Attempt': Sept 2026.
Include data-testid attributes on key elements like sidebar links, buttons, table rows, and forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Add micro-animations to all interactive elements, but DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and clear focus states.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Ensure all text over varied backgrounds meets the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
